exposure: out-of-hospital delivery (home and freestanding birth center)
cohort: 109,970 singleton, term, vertex, nonanomolous, and liveborn neonates born to women with a history of cesarean delivery in the United States between 2007 and 2010
finding: Neonates born out-of-hospital after VBAC had higher odds of adverse outcomes, including neonatal seizures, low Apgar scores, and neonatal death, compared to those born in-hospital.
mod_finding: Neonates born out-of-hospital after VBAC had higher odds of adverse outcomes.
